messages:
sophia: quick sync — postmortem up for the late-night rollout that created a regional tail-latency plateau. want to convert findings into concrete rollout/flag fixes + owners. keeping replies short.

leo: I can take rollout gating changes (speed/profile + validator). target: PR + unit tests by Thu.

diane: I'll own feature-flag scoping and per-tenant blast-radius defaults. will propose defaults for demo/internal/public/private.

andrew: i'll own auto-rollback tuning and metric selection. thinking 95p latency, total_error_rate, and model-quality-delta. i'll write RFC.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Postmortem available: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-22-regional-tail-latency-plateau

sophia: action items (for tracking sheet):
- leo: rollout validator + slowed profile + rollout CI checks (ENG-3054)
- diane: flag scoping + tenant defaults (ENG-3055)
- andrew: auto-rollback RFC + tests + playbook updates (RFC-3499)
send PRs/issues here. i'll keep the tracker updated and schedule follow-up.

leo: proposed slowed rollout snippet i'll put in PR; drafts below for discussion:

```
rollout_policy:
  steps:
    - { pct: 2, duration: 900 }   # initial canary
    - { pct: 10, duration: 1800, hold: 600 }
    - { pct: 25, duration: 3600 }
    - { pct: 100, duration: 7200 }
  validators:
    - name: latency_check
      metric: p95_latency
      max_pct_increase: 0.15
    - name: error_rate_check
      metric: error_rate
      max_absolute: 0.02
```

diane: for private tenants default max_pct=10 and require manual override with SRE approval. public default max_pct=25. will add to ENG-3055.

andrew: auto-rollback sketch: window_sec=180, triggers = [p95_latency_up_20pct, error_rate_up_2pct, quality_drop_significant]. rollback action: immediate 0% and alert on-call + owner. will quantify in RFC.

leo: also adding a validator that prevents >10% to private tenants unless flag.allow_high_blast is true + approver field.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Rollout config change proposed in PR #789 by @leo for staging.

leo: PR #789: https://git.redwood.net/redwood/rollouts/pull/789 — requesting reviews from @andrew and @diane.

andrew: creating RFC-3499: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RFC-3499 (assigning to @andrew) ETA Mon for draft thresholds.

diane: created ENG-3055: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-3055 (flag scoping) — aiming to have tenant-policy table and playbook edits by Fri COB.

sophia: note on recurring pattern: we saw similar tail-latency blips after 3 prior rollouts in last 6 weeks. please include a regression test that replays the traffic shape we saw in test harness.

andrew: will add synthetic replay to the rollback unit tests and add a canary-quality check in CI.

leo: timeline recap: PR by Thu, tests + validator by Fri, deploy to staging after approvals. sync Wed 09:30 if needed.

sophia: thanks. i'll publish the owner + ticket summary in the postmortem and close the loop. reopen thread for blockers. :white_check_mark:
